title: Only 7% Can Name These Legendary Actors
summary: Ten photographs from cinema history. See how many legendary actors you can name from their faces.

landing.intro:
10 famous portraits. One film challenge.
How many actors can you name?

about.body:
This entertainment quiz features ten photo questions about celebrated actors from classic cinema and later screen history. Each question presents an actor's photograph and four possible names.

Look closely at the face and use the clue only if you need it. Correct answers stay hidden until the final reveal.

Images and source-question concepts are reproduced from QuizDays with permission stated by the site owner commissioning this quiz.

steps: Study each photograph and read the short clue.
Choose one of the four actor names.
Reveal your score and full answer review after question ten.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general film-trivia purposes only.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your classic-cinema score and complete actor reveal are ready.

profile-1.title: The Hollywood Historian
profile-1.copy: You recognised the faces, eras and screen legends with extraordinary precision. Very few classic-film challenges are likely to catch you out.

profile-2.title: The Silver-Screen Expert
profile-2.copy: You know your leading men and international stars. A few carefully chosen faces stood between you and a flawless performance.

profile-3.title: The Classic Film Fan
profile-3.copy: You recognised a strong selection of cinema's most familiar faces. The full reveal may introduce a few legends worth rediscovering.

profile-4.title: The Movie-Night Regular
profile-4.copy: Some stars clicked instantly while others belonged to a different corner of screen history. Your answer review fills in every missing name.

profile-5.title: The Opening Credits
profile-5.copy: These legendary faces made this a demanding first reel. Now that you have seen the names, the next classic-cinema challenge may look very different.
